intent: Clickable action control with a fixed set of sizes and visual variants.
useWhen: Submitting a form or triggering a primary workflow action
Offering a secondary or tertiary action alongside content
Destructive actions that need explicit danger styling
Toolbar or compact actions with a Lucide icon and a visible label
Icon-only actions when space is tight and ariaLabel names the action
doNotUseWhen: Navigation that should be a link — use an anchor styled elsewhere
Icon-only without aria-label — icon-only must set ariaLabel
More than one primary button in the same view

iconStart.note: lucide-react export name from the Foundations catalog (Plus, ArrowRight, …)

iconEnd.note: lucide-react export name from the Foundations catalog (Plus, ArrowRight, …)

shape.note: pill uses radius-pill. Drawer footers use pill.

requirements: Visible label via children, OR aria-label for icon-only
disabled sets aria-disabled and prevents interaction
Focus ring must be visible on keyboard focus

doNot: Do not invent local Button variants outside the enum
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not place more than one variant=primary Button in a single view
Do not pass custom SVG or React nodes as icons — use lucide-react export names on iconStart/iconEnd
Do not ship icon-only without ariaLabel
